name: cloudbrowser-live
description: The public AI browser session — one agent, one window, anonymous and always on.

scripts.fn:deploy: npx @insforge/cli functions deploy openagents-bridge --file ./functions/openagents-bridge/index.ts --name 'OpenAgents bridge' --description 'Pulls events from browserfabric and forwards visitor messages.'
scripts.secrets:set: echo 'Set with: npx @insforge/cli secrets set OPENAGENTS_API <url>; OPENAGENTS_NETWORK <id>; OPENAGENTS_CHANNEL <id>; OPENAGENTS_TOKEN <token>'
